title: Either is enough
prompt: Shipping of robot parts is free if the order total is 50 or more, OR if the customer is a member. Return true if shipping is free.
hints: or is true when at least one side is true.

docs.what: Comparisons. Each gives true or false.

docs.name: and  or  not
docs.what: and is true when both sides are; or when at least one is; not flips true and false.

solution:
func solve(total, is_member):
	return total >= 50 or is_member
